text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good grief! There is no way on earth
I could eat the "world's smelliest cake"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Why not? It sounds super fun!
And here I went out of my way to buy it
so we could eat it together, McQueen~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, bring something more delicious... No,
at least bring a normal cake, if you please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after schoolーー
While watching the usual quarrel between
Mejiro McQueen and Gold Ship...
If you hate it that much, I wouldn't mind eating it for ya.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That voice isーー

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You saved me. I had no idea you fancied
such peculiar delicacies, Nakayama-san... But
to each their own, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To each their favorite things.
Truly, this is how the world ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, milady.
Nobody said I'd eat it for free.
How aboutーー

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We settle this with a gamble!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A gamble...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you beat me, I'll polish off that cake just like
you wanted. Well? You in?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I'm in!
Think you can beat our invincible tag team?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! Why are you getting so excited about this?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
'Cause if we don't take the bet,
we'll be stuck eating that cake unconditionally, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who brought it in the first placeーー
...Ah, jeez! If it's come to this,
we absolutely have to win! Gold Ship-san!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Win and it's heaven, lose and it's hell!
Yeah... this is great! Standing on the razor's edge!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This feeling... This is it.
This is what I've been looking for...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(That point of no return,
the absolute resolve not to lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, El.
This feeling was the whole point...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (That's the only thing you were missing.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? Getting cold feet over a two-on-one?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nah, just got distracted by some minor business.
Thinking about how to push someone to their absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you over there.
You're good at coaching horse girls, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. What kind of method do you use
to teach a feeling that words can't describe?
choice_data_list: I think you just have to wait for them to realize it.
Maybe make them experience it directly?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I see, whether they realize it or not...
...So it's a gamble, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Looks like the side chat is over.
Then let's get this party started! The battle to the extreme!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, perfect... My hair's standing on end.
Let's keep the game simple: Rock-paper-scissors.
Rock, paperーー

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two-on-one proved to be too disadvantageous,
and Nakayama Festa lost the game,
resulting in her having to eat the cake, butーー

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Mmph...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! The smell is nasty,
but it's actually pretty damn tasty?! This totally works!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the cake
was very much to Nakayama Festa's taste.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Drastic times call for drastic measures, huh?
You're quite bold, contrary to how you look.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Though I don't dislike that style at all.
I'll show her what a real showdown looks like...!

Then let's get this party started! The battle to the extreme!!
